note: Acceptance cases for the 0.5.0 rebuild. Each case sets up the synthetic world (world.json) through public entry points, performs one operation, and checks observable results. Agent-written records are given verbatim so the checks are deterministic; model judgement (review verdicts, extraction quality) is measured by the evaluation, not here. Aliases in the records are frozen search words the agent would write (plan: bilingual aliases); this set tests that search uses them, not that an agent writes good ones.

steps.capture: send the session's hook events (prompt, edits, stop) through the capture hook for its host
steps.trace: issue a trace draft for the session, write the record, check, save
steps.harvest: issue a harvest draft for the pull request (fake gh serves world.json), write the record, check, save
steps.glean: issue a glean draft in the given session, write the record, check, save
steps.edit_file: change a world file in the temp repository and commit
steps.inject: run the delivery hook for an event (session_start | pre_edit | pre_read | prompt), or a sequence of them in one session, and capture each additional context
steps.review_select: run the decision-check selection for a diff and return the applicable units and the lane state
steps.as_of: export the evaluation snapshot as of a time and query it
steps.overview: call the MCP overview tool (view live or look) in the temp repository
steps.export: check the save path and build the export document of the chosen decisions, as the read server's export tool does
steps.set_remote: point the temp repository's origin at another spelling of its remote
